speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes; to determine the cause, can you tell me your age and any history of smoking or alcohol use?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming the duration and severity of your symptoms. To help narrow down the cause of your weight loss and night sweats, have you recently experienced any fevers, or do you have a history of tuberculosis, HIV, or stomach cancer?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The description of a "fixed" and non-tender supraclavicular lymph node is highly concerning for malignancy. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as constipation or diarrhea, or any difficulty swallowing? Also, do you have a history of smoking?

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The feeling of early satiety and clothing tightness suggests significant abdominal organ enlargement. Have you noticed any visible lumps in your abdomen or back, and do you have a history of peptic ulcers or blood in your stool?
